statement: AMD reported only $222 million of remaining performance obligations on contracts longer than one year as of June 27, 2026, of which $144 million is expected within 12 months.
why: AMD's disclosed backlog is tiny next to its quarterly revenue, so the desk cannot use RPO as a forward-demand gauge for this vendor the way it can for cloud providers.

impact.mechanism: AMD books accelerator sales largely on short-cycle purchase orders rather than multi-year contracts, so reported RPO understates the multi-gigawatt commitments described elsewhere and gives a weak forward signal.

evidence.excerpt: As of June 27, 2026, the aggregate transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations under contracts with an original expected duration of more than one year was $222 million, of which $144 million is expected to be recognized in the next 12 months.

confidence.basis: Exact RPO disclosure quoted from AMD's Form 10-Q, a primary filing.
